title: An ending motive meets changing feelings

captions.energy: Ending an earlier form of participation

meaning: Retained shared action alongside a motive to end an earlier form can coexist with a changing emotional response.
text: The Devil in the physical position of this Energy Field concerns shared actions around attachment, where familiar participation is difficult to stop freely. Death in energy motivates finishing an earlier form or phase rather than continuing automatically. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions adds an experience of changing circumstances. A noticeable mismatch may appear: you still repeat a familiar action while motivation already turns towards closure. The emotional response changes as attempts to finish unfold, without establishing one correct choice on behalf of both people.

For example, you hold another familiar club gathering after deciding to close its former format. Declining one final additional occasion is difficult, although the motive for ending is already clear. A guest cancellation initially brings relief, then regret, while another idea restores interest. **We want to finish the earlier form, while participation and feelings still follow a familiar circle.** This alternation cancels no motive and proves no need for endless continuation. An emotional turn and a practical decision remain different aspects of the transition.

A difficulty arises if every new response becomes a reason to postpone closure. The constraint remains beneath apparent attention to changing events. Death as motivation requires no immediate disappearance of attachment, and the Wheel promises no final relief at the next turn. The Devil matters through difficulty in choosing freely: action may still be retained while the emotional experience of transition remains different for both people. Neither a pleasant nor a difficult moment by itself determines what must follow.
